weakness: Hold a still beam; they lock on the glass and sit.
notes: Treats the chimney like a second moon.

weakness: Cover the lantern; they stall when the lure dies.
notes: Hindwings flash soot-gray, then vanish on bark.
Drinks dew off grass; nets easy if you kneel.

weakness: Drop the shutter; they overshoot a dying light.
notes: Hovers at the lantern lip; wait for the sip.

weakness: Outshine their flash; your lantern wins the courtship.
notes: Males blink a slow two-count over wet ground; the steady green beads are females, leave them.

weakness: Chimney heat; they bolt from warm soil.
notes: Patrols the path after rain; clicks if you pinch too hard.

weakness: Sudden full beam; they freeze, then ricochet.
notes: Antennae longer than the body; follows the cool of stone.

weakness: Sidestep, then pin; they charge the light in a straight line.
notes: Too fast to net from the front; wait for the halt.

weakness: Shade the lantern; your glow steals their lure.
notes: Wingless female, a green bead in the grass; not a spark, don't pocket it dry.

weakness: Heat and smoke of the lantern; they peel off the plume.
notes: Hunts ears and wrists; one will call ten.

weakness: Smoke and back off; never swing.
notes: Paper nest under eaves; a strike makes the whole porch yours to lose.

weakness: Pluck a radial thread, lantern behind you.
notes: Rebuilds the same gate every dusk; walk through and you'll wear her.
